answer: Mooring bond stops bulk fake identities. Each identity moors one timber buoy on a karst chart, locking a 70-credit bond and chaining copper to an anchor post. An auditor replays the chart each epoch: one post, one chain; a second chain, a copied line, or a rented post burns the bond. First mooring is 40, the k-th 40+8(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 4,036,000 plus 70,000 locked against a 40,000 pool. An honest agent moors once, pays 40, keeps its share.
